name: definition-of-ready-done
description: Define Definition of Ready (DoR) + Definition of Done (DoD) + acceptance-criteria standardization. DoR: criteria a backlog item must meet before entering a sprint. DoD: criteria for the increment to be considered done. Per-level DoD (story / sprint / release). Acceptance criteria format (Given-When-Then / checklist / example-mapping), team-level vs org-level DoD, exceptions + waiver process. Self-assessment checklist before committing / shipping. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
